summary: Iteration 5 tested the onboarding feature on the backend and frontend. Backend: 14 new pytest tests in test_onboarding.py all pass, and the full regression suite passes (97/97). /api/speak returns an audio_url, caches it per text and serves audio/mpeg; empty text, text over 600 chars and a missing body return 422. /api/onboarding/parse extracts the right fields from all 3 test mp3s (Mike; 162 in, 53 ft, 80000 lb, no hazmat; avoid_tolls, Love's and Pilot, 4 h). An invalid step returns 422, empty audio returns 400 and garbage audio returns empty updates. break_hours 0 or 20 and more than 8 chains return 422. 'take me to San Francisco' gives a different HERE route with avoid_tolls true (155 mi) than false (87 mi), and the reply uses 'Mike'. Frontend at 375x667: fresh storage redirects to /onboarding. All 4 steps work, the agent line changes per step and uses the name. Next is disabled for an empty or whitespace name and for invalid truck values (onboarding-truck-error shows). Prefs toggles and chips work, the summary is correct and 'Start driving' opens the map with the chip updated. Reload does not show onboarding again, menu-button reopens it prefilled and Skip saves defaults. Voice answers with a fake mic work for all 3 steps (fields update and onboarding-heard shows 'Got it: ...'). TTS /api/speak fires for each step. The break reminder fires after 1 h of an active route (tested with page.clock): it sends /api/speak 'Hey Mike, you've been driving for 1 hours...'. The main voice flow still works and the reply uses the driver name. Bugs found: (1) HIGH: saving in the truck-profile editor deletes driver_name, avoid_tolls, avoid_ferries_tunnels, favorite_chains and break_hours. (2) MEDIUM: reopening onboarding from the menu and then finishing leaves 2 map screens mounted. Plus minor issues. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: HERE still returns a route with notice 'tollTransponder' even with avoid[features]=tollRoad, because every route into SF crosses a toll bridge. The agent then says 'Heads up, this route includes tolls' although the prompt says preferences are applied. Better wording: 'I couldn't avoid every toll (bridge toll)'. Reference: services/routing.py:69,95
There is no audio size limit (/api/voice has a 25MB limit and returns 413). Reference: server.py:162
The endpoint has no auth and accepts any text up to 600 chars, so anyone can use it for TTS and run up cost. _SPEAK_CACHE also grows without limit. Reference: server.py:143-155

ui_bugs.issue: saveTruckProfile({height_in, trailer_ft, weight_lb, hazmat}) replaces the whole profile, so the onboarding name and preferences are lost. Verified: localStorage after Save only has the 4 truck fields. Fix: saveTruckProfile({...truck, height_in: ..., ...}). Reference: app/truck-profile.tsx:91

menu-button calls router.push('/onboarding') and finish calls router.replace('/'). This leaves the stack as [index, index]: 2 copilot-avatar-button and 2 menu-button in the DOM after one reopen. That means 2 maps, 2 GPS watchers and 2 break-reminder intervals (the reminder may be spoken twice). Fix: router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/'), or router.dismissTo('/'). Reference: app/onboarding.tsx:148
The name is not trimmed. 'Mike ' becomes 'Nice to meet you, Mike !' and is saved with the trailing space. Reference: app/onboarding.tsx:96,249
It fires only once per route although the label says 'Every N h'. Also says '1 hours' when break_hours=1 (voice can set 1). Reference: app/index.tsx:91-94

integration_issues.issue: A voice answer replaces favorite_chains instead of adding to chips the driver already selected. Reference: app/onboarding.tsx:141
Tapping Next while the mic is listening keeps recording. The answer is then parsed for the new step. Stop or cancel recording when the step changes.

issues: The agent bubble has key={step + name}, so it re-runs the FadeIn on every keystroke in the name field (the bubble flickers while typing). Reference: app/onboarding.tsx:238
The Switch touch target is 40x20 on web and only the switch itself can be tapped. Make the whole ToggleRow pressable (min 44 px).
Chips set accessibilityState.selected, but aria-selected does not reach the DOM (PressableScale may not pass it through). This hurts accessibility and test assertions.
Reopening from the menu starts with 'Hi! I'm TruckBuddy... What's your name?' even when the name is already known. Consider a returning-user line.

action_items: HIGH: truck-profile.tsx:91 should merge into the existing profile ({...truck, ...dims}) so driver_name and preferences survive Save.
MEDIUM: onboarding finish() should go back when there is history (router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')) so no duplicate index/map screen is left.
Trim driver_name before using and saving it.
Make the break reminder repeat every break_hours and fix '1 hours'.
When HERE returns a toll notice with avoid_tolls on, say tolls could not be fully avoided.
Optional: merge voice favorite_chains, cancel recording on step change, add a size limit to onboarding/parse, use a stable key for the bubble animation.
critical_code_review_comments: useTruckProfile load() only notifies listeners when a stored value exists. Onboarding's useEffect([saved]) resets the draft whenever saved changes, so typing before the async load finishes on a cold /onboarding deep link would be overwritten.
storage saves truck_profile_v1 JSON-encoded twice (a string inside JSON). It works, but it is inconsistent.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) found.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows pass; editor-save data loss and duplicate map screen bugs)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fake mic: page.add_init_script that overrides navigator.permissions.query (microphone -> granted) and navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia. It decodes the base64 mp3 from localStorage '__fake_mp3' via AudioContext into a MediaStreamDestination (src.start(ctx.currentTime+0.6), loop false) and sets window.__fakeDur. Set __fake_mp3 before each mic tap; no reload needed. Wait for the duration plus 1.2 s, then tap again. Onboarding mp3s are in /tmp/onb_*.mp3 (read them in Python and base64 them); main-flow phrases are in /tmp/*.b64. To test the break reminder: page.clock.install() before reload, then clock.fast_forward('01:02:00') after a route is set, and watch the /api/speak requests. Mark the user onboarded with localStorage onboarded_v1='true' and truck_profile_v1=JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(profile)).
rca_of_issue: Prefs loss: truck-profile.tsx builds a new 4-field object, and saveTruckProfile replaces `current` and storage with it. Duplicate screen: push('/onboarding') + replace('/') in Expo Router stack replaces onboarding with a NEW index route instead of popping back to the existing one.
